verdict.rationale: Helicone documents versioning, comparison and instant rollback, but only for managed prompts: commit histories and tags, version comparison, and per-environment deployment. Its other automation surfaces (webhooks, alerts, routing, rate-limit rules) show no versioning, review or rollback in the evidence. Missing for 10: versioning/rollback for webhook, alert and routing configurations; a review/approval workflow beyond version comparison; independent or hands-on corroboration of prompt rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Track every change, compare versions, and rollback instantly if something goes wrong
Save any prompt with clear commit histories and tags.
Deploy different versions to production, staging, and development environments independently
